The International Monetary Fund’s new World Economic Outlook forecasts global real growth of 3.1% in 2026, up from its July projection of 3.0%, and 3.4% in 2027. The IMF says strong spending on AI infrastructure partly.

NFIB’s September Small Business Optimism Index fell 0.8 point to 97.9, just below its long-run average of 98.0. Its Uncertainty Index climbed to 90 versus a historical average of 68. Owners most often named labor.

The National Association of REALTORS® reported September existing-home sales of 3.99 million at a seasonally adjusted annual rate, up 1.5% from August but down 2.2% from September 2025. Listings increased to 1.60.
Anthropic described Scion, its new internal server-centric source-control system, after migrating a monorepo from Git in five months.
Cloudflare added its first event type to the Cloudflare API MCP server: Workers Issues error notifications.
AWS added configurable metadata fields to Agent Registry records covering agents, MCP servers, agent skills, gateways and custom resources.
Databricks introduced Private Network Gateway (PNG) to connect serverless compute to customer-controlled private network resources using one managed, network-level attachment.
Amazon ECS introduced `LiveTaskCount`, a free service metric that counts active tasks even when their desired state is changing.
HashiCorp released Terraform Provider for Vault 5.13.0 with several infrastructure-as-code controls previously requiring manual configuration.
Ivanti disclosed CVE-2026-104935, an authentication-bypass flaw in Connect Secure that can let a remote unauthenticated attacker run commands on an appliance.
L3Harris says the first VAMPIRE counter-unmanned-aircraft systems have been delivered to the U.S.
AWS Security Hub now includes resource criticality in exposure prioritization.
The BLS reported that September’s Consumer Price Index rose 0.6% after seasonal adjustment, lifting the twelve-month headline rate from August’s 3.4% to 3.7%.
The Social Security Administration announced a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment for 2027, covering retirement, disability, survivor and Supplemental Security Income programs.
The Federal Reserve’s October Beige Book found moderate growth in two of twelve Districts, modest growth in three, slight growth in four and little change in three.
GitHub made AI Scan for pull requests and agentic autofix of code-scanning alerts generally available on October 15.
AWS added its AI/ML SageMaker skill to the supported Agent Toolkit for AWS, replacing previous independent Labs skills and plugins.
Anthropic announced six METR evaluators have begun employee-like embedded access to its internal model-risk operations and can publish independent findings.
GitHub introduced preview Actions workflow lockfiles that bind action and reusable-workflow references to fixed commits and support Dependabot updates.
